name: llama.cpp
description: Provides a provider for llama.cpp using an OpenAI-compatible /v1 HTTP API.
project_description: An AI-module provider plugin that registers a self-hosted llama.cpp server (llama-server) as an AI provider through its OpenAI-compatible /v1 HTTP API. It supports chat completions and embeddings, auto-discovers the available models from the server's /v1/models endpoint (caching the mapping in Drupal State so the model list survives an offline server), and requires no API key — it is built for local and privately-hosted inference where prompt data stays on operator-controlled infrastructure. Configuration is a single admin form for the server host name and port. Note: the project is marked obsolete upstream, with development moved to a multi-instance successor.
